other_conditions: Must have passed Class XII in any stream or equivalent for B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Administration at the Institute of Hotel Management.

Must have passed Class X or XII in any stream or equivalent for Diploma courses in tourism or hospitality related subjects such as Food Production, Food & Beverage Service, Front Office, Housekeeping, Bakery & Confectionaries.
Must be a graduate in any stream for Post Graduate Diploma in tourism or hospitality related subjects.
Merit list is drawn based on the percentage of marks obtained under the criteria.
benefits_summary: Sponsorship for selected students to pursue B.Sc., Diploma or PG Diploma courses in tourism and hospitality.
